status: Fixed generic hypothesis after preserved V1 numerical rejection, before new access/field execution
motivation: Saved V1 diagnostics include small reachable road patches at 900 minutes (5,107,2814 active physical spans for three origins), with long 25kmh input/local-grid paths dominating the worst losses. One additional origin is rejected by the generalized lake mask. This motivates an origin-access experiment; it does not establish missing source junctions or correct real routes.
policy: Keep the original eligible primary connection. Also consider every eligible retained-road segment foot and endpoint within primary connector distance plus 1000 meters, capped at the existing 300km/720min source access ceiling. Price each entire input-to-foot connection separately at the existing25kmh rule. All are initial alternatives from the input, never graph-to-local-to-graph transfers during routing.
radiusBasis: 1000m is the existing short-span/index length bound and first source-access fallback radius. It is one fixed coverage/access proxy, not a calibrated distance or a guarantee of real local-road access; no per-origin or post-score radius choice.
maskOmission: Only if the original input is outside the generalized land mask, allow an initial connection to a modeled road foot within100m. This uses the existing100m source-vertex geometry simplification budget as a coarse uncertainty assumption, not a proof that the original point is on a real road or land. The full positive connector is priced. Inputs on the land mask keep the original strict continuous-land rule for connections beyond1m; no water-prefix relaxation inside local/grid/road links.
duplicates: Deduplicate exact graph-vertex connections by actual vertex identity; interior connections by canonical physical arc and geometric rank. Retain the lowest separately priced cost for an identical state. Do not merge distinct roads/grade-separated crossings. Overflow fails explicitly; no silent truncation or source/query replacement.
multiSourceField: Later extend incoming-arc Dijkstra with all priced initial vertex/partial seeds. Preserve a regular-entry shadow per seeded arc and all initial rank/directional prefixes, so a cheap suffix cannot imply a free upstream prefix. No road weights, direction/access/turn rules, geography coordinates, cases or reference gates change.
firstExperiment: Qualify the access collector with synthetic controls, then measure all79 original unique endpoint inputs without reading/scoring new provider times. Preserve the original failure and all original connection identities, report any unsupported input or cap failure. Do not select only problematic places.
qualification: This is a separately versioned candidate. All83/35 numerical/shading,166 road/local witness, physical/source/shore, full app/retained/package/startup/API/shared-camera gates remain.
